# Cover brief: The Soother Fell Into Dragon Land

A small girl in a yellow raincoat and red boots holds a round blue soother up to a green sky, beside a tiny orange dragon with a brown satchel, a bubble-gum volcano puffing pink bubbles behind them. Soft, rounded shapes and warm pastel colours; cozy, giggly and safe.
